plan.question: Can the same fixed forecasts support operator-controlled larger per-visit batches while respecting explicit handling,source,drop,vehicle and10min limits?
plan.hypothesis: All72 synthetic conditions satisfy conservation/handling/expiry/source/drop limits and at least one bulk feasible delivery batch>=5bikes; no accuracy or real efficiency inference.

prior_art.title: OSRM official API reference
prior_art.verified_scope: Previously checked directed table/route units and car-profile limits; no measured truck or traffic inference
prior_art.difference_to_test: Operator batch/resource assumptions and handling-aware feasible quantity search, not novel VRP global optimization

data.observed_truth: Synthetic physical feasibility checks; actual API current stock is input, no action/outcome truth

baselines: compact cap6/target2/budget6/drop3 under same handling value
bulk cap20/target6/budget20/drop10; changed operational policy explicitly, not same-resource improvement claim
evaluation.success_rule: Zero violations in72synthetic conditions plus>=1bulk delivery batch5bikes or more.
evaluation.failure_rule: Preserve runtime,zero-action and failure; no relaxed time/source bounds or outcome-based tuning
evaluation.exclusion_rule: Keep all72conditions; reject missing/stale/mismatched input without zero fill; integration replay separated from actual now issuance
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: Finite engineering checks and assumed operational scenarios, no statistical field benefit or prediction-accuracy claim
evaluation.seed_plan: Seed44; unchanged H13 actual state marginals for one integration snapshot; no fitting.
